description: This Kotlin source file defines classes and functions for generating and updating project dependency graphs, specifically for a Gradle-based Android project. It includes classes for representing dependency graphs, tasks for dumping graph data to files, and tasks for updating Markdown documentation with the generated graphs.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a project dependency graph, capable of recursively collecting dependencies and associated plugins.

classes.name: PluginType
classes.description: Enumeration of plugin types with associated identifiers, references, and styles for graph visualization.

classes.name: GraphDumpTask
classes.description: Gradle task that dumps project dependencies into a mermaid-compatible format for visualization.

classes.name: GraphUpdateTask
classes.description: Gradle task that updates a Markdown file with the latest dependency graph visualization.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Main method in Graph class that recursively collects dependencies and plugins starting from a root project.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Returns a map of project paths to their dependencies in a structured format.

methods.name: plugins
methods.description: Returns a map of project paths to their associated plugin types.

methods.name: configureGraphTasks
methods.description: Configures Gradle tasks for dumping and updating project dependency graphs.

methods.name: mermaid
methods.description: Generates a mermaid diagram string representing the dependency graph.

methods.name: legend
methods.description: Generates a legend string for the dependency graph visualization.

methods.name: classDef
methods.description: Defines a class style for a plugin type in the graph.

methods.name: link
methods.description: Creates a link representation between dependencies for the graph.

methods.name: alias
methods.description: Creates an alias string for a project node in the graph.

methods.name: toDependency
methods.description: Converts a pair of strings into a Dependency object.

methods.name: trimTrailingNewLines
methods.description: Removes trailing blank lines from a string.
